narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Four thousand is sixty six sixties and forty.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>The sum is right, but sixty six is too many for one place.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Sixty of those sixties must move up to the next landmark.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble shows 66 in the sixties box and 40 in the ones box; the 66 flashes; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Take out the biggest landmark that fits, then the next, until less than sixty is left.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>No place may hold sixty or more.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Your turn. Group three thousand seven hundred into the landmarks of base sixty.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor; two lines appear: biggest landmark first; no place holds sixty or more; then a new line: group 3700 into base sixty landmarks, with an empty box
